senses.en: before anything else

ex.en: First of all, let me thank everyone for coming.
ex.zh: 首先，感谢大家的到来。

ex.en: First of all, wash your hands.
ex.zh: 首先，洗一下手。

tip: first of all 用于列举时的第一点，类似 firstly。
scene: A teacher raising one finger to say first of all to a class.

senses.en: a person who plays football

ex.en: His dream is to become a famous football player.
ex.zh: 他的梦想是成为著名的足球运动员。

ex.en: The football player scored two goals in the match.
ex.zh: 这名足球运动员在比赛中进了两个球。

tip: football player 和 footballer 意思相同，都是足球运动员。
scene: A footballer in a red shirt kicking a ball towards a goal.

senses.en: a person who plays football

ex.en: She is a talented footballer on the school team.
ex.zh: 她是校队里很有天赋的足球运动员。

ex.en: The footballer waved to the fans after the game.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，这位足球运动员向球迷挥手。

tip: footballer 是英式常用说法，即足球运动员。
scene: A footballer in a team jersey waving to cheering fans in a stadium.

senses.en: used to show purpose, who receives, or duration

ex.en: This gift is for you.
ex.zh: 这份礼物是给你的。

ex.en: We stayed in London for three days.
ex.zh: 我们在伦敦待了三天。

col: for a long time｜很长时间
tip: for 后接时间段表示“持续多久”；since 后接时间点表示“自从”。
scene: A wrapped gift with a ribbon being handed to a smiling girl.

senses.en: available to be bought

ex.en: There is a sign that says 'for sale' outside the house.
ex.zh: 房子外面有一块写着“出售”的牌子。

ex.en: These paintings are not for sale.
ex.zh: 这些画是非卖品。

tip: for sale 是“待出售”；on sale 是“打折促销中”。
scene: A house with a for sale sign standing in a garden.

senses.en: to return to a place, or to get something again

ex.en: What time did you get back from school?
ex.zh: 你几点从学校回来的？

ex.en: I got my money back from the shop.
ex.zh: 我从商店拿回了钱。

tip: get back 可指“返回”或“收回”；get back home 回家。
scene: A girl walking back home through the front door carrying a school bag.

senses.en: to put on clothes

ex.en: Get dressed quickly or we'll miss the bus!
ex.zh: 快点穿好衣服，不然我们会错过公交车！

ex.en: He got dressed and went downstairs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他穿好衣服下楼吃早餐。

tip: get dressed 强调“穿上衣服”的动作；be dressed 强调状态。
scene: A boy putting on a t-shirt in his bedroom in the morning.

senses.en: to become healthy and strong through exercise

ex.en: She runs every day to get fit.
ex.zh: 她每天跑步来健身。

ex.en: Joining a sports club can help you get fit.
ex.zh: 加入体育俱乐部可以帮助你保持健康。

tip: get fit 表示“变得健康强壮”；keep fit 表示“保持健康”。
scene: A woman jogging in a park with headphones on, looking energetic.

senses.en: to become husband and wife

ex.en: They are going to get married next spring.
ex.zh: 他们明年春天要结婚了。

ex.en: My cousin got married last weekend.
ex.zh: 我表哥上周末结婚了。

tip: get married 表示“结婚”的动作；be married 表示“已婚”状态。
scene: A happy couple in wedding clothes cutting a cake in a garden.

senses.en: to leave a bus, train, bike or horse

ex.en: We get off the bus at the next stop.
ex.zh: 我们在下一站下车。

ex.en: Please get off your bike at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口下车（自行车）。

col: get off the bus｜下公交车
tip: get off 表示“下车/下马”；反义词是 get on（上车）。
scene: Passengers stepping down from a bus at a city bus stop.

senses.en: to enter a bus, train, plane or bike

ex.en: We got on the train just before it left.
ex.zh: 我们正好在火车开走前上了车。

ex.en: She got on her bike and rode away.
ex.zh: 她骑上自行车走了。

col: get on with someone｜和某人相处
tip: get on 表示“上车”；get on with sb 是“与某人相处融洽”。
scene: A child stepping up onto a school bus, holding the handrail.

senses.en: to get out of bed, or to stand up

ex.en: I get up at seven every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上七点起床。

ex.en: He got up from his chair to greet us.
ex.zh: 他从椅子上站起来迎接我们。

tip: get up 是“起床并起身”；wake up 只是“醒来”。
scene: A boy stretching as he climbs out of bed in a sunny bedroom.

senses.en: a girl or woman that a person has a romantic relationship with

ex.en: His girlfriend gave him a scarf for his birthday.
ex.zh: 他女朋友送了他一条围巾作生日礼物。

ex.en: They have been girlfriend and boyfriend for two years.
ex.zh: 他们交往两年了。

tip: girlfriend 表示恋爱对象；女性朋友一般说 female friend。
scene: A girl giving a wrapped scarf to a boy at a birthday table.

senses.en: to return something to its owner

ex.en: Don't forget to give back the library book.
ex.zh: 别忘了把图书馆的书还回去。

ex.en: She gave back the money she borrowed.
ex.zh: 她把借的钱还了。

tip: give back 强调“归还给别人”；give it back 中 it 放中间。
scene: A student returning a library book at the library desk.

senses.en: to move or travel somewhere

ex.en: We go to school by bike.
ex.zh: 我们骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们去公园吧。

tip: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone/been。
scene: Two children riding bikes along a road towards a school.

senses.en: to leave home to do something

ex.en: We are going out for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我们今晚出去吃晚饭。

ex.en: She goes out with her friends every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每周六和朋友一起出去。

col: go out with someone｜和某人约会
tip: go out 表示“外出”；go out with sb 表示“与某人交往”。
scene: Two friends walking out of the front door together in the evening.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the afternoon

ex.en: Good afternoon, everyone. Welcome to our school.
ex.zh: 大家下午好，欢迎来到我们学校。

ex.en: 'Good afternoon,' said the shop assistant.
ex.zh: “下午好，”店员说。

tip: good afternoon 用于下午的正式问候（12点后至傍晚）。
scene: A shop assistant greeting a customer with a smile in the afternoon.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the evening

ex.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
ex.zh: 女士们先生们，晚上好。

ex.en: We said good evening to the hotel manager.
ex.zh: 我们向酒店经理问晚上好。

tip: good evening 用于傍晚及晚上的问候；晚安说 good night。
scene: A hotel receptionist greeting a guest at the front desk in the evening.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the morning

ex.en: Good morning, class!
ex.zh: 同学们，早上好！

ex.en: She wished us good morning as we came in.
ex.zh: 我们进来时她向我们问早安。

tip: good morning 用于早晨的问候（到中午前）。
scene: A teacher greeting students with a smile at the classroom door in the morning.

senses.en: said when you say goodbye at night or go to bed

ex.en: Good night, sleep well.
ex.zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。

ex.en: Mum kissed me and said good night.
ex.zh: 妈妈亲了我一下，说了晚安。

tip: good night 用于道别或睡前；即使天黑见面也用 good evening。
scene: A mother tucking her child into bed and switching off the light.

senses.en: pleasant to look at; attractive

ex.en: He is a good-looking young man.
ex.zh: 他是个好看的年轻人。

ex.en: The good-looking actress smiled at the camera.
ex.zh: 漂亮的女演员对着镜头微笑。

tip: good-looking 用于形容人长相好看；比较级 more good-looking。
scene: A smiling young man in a blue shirt looking at himself in a mirror.

senses.en: a word you say when leaving or finishing a call

ex.en: She waved goodbye to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她向祖父母挥手告别。

ex.en: We said goodbye and got on the train.
ex.zh: 我们道别后上了火车。

tip: goodbye 较正式；bye 更口语。道别用 say goodbye to。
scene: A girl waving goodbye to her grandparents at a train station.

senses.en: the child of your son or daughter

ex.en: Their grandchild visits them every Sunday.
ex.zh: 他们的孙子每周日来看他们。

ex.en: Grandpa loves reading stories to his grandchild.
ex.zh: 爷爷喜欢给孙辈读故事。

tip: grandchild 复数 grandchildren；分性别说 grandson/granddaughter。
scene: A grandfather reading a picture book to a grandchild on a sofa.

senses.en: informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Grandma bakes the best apple pie.
ex.zh: 奶奶烤的苹果派最好吃。

ex.en: We visited my grandma in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我们去乡下看望了外婆。

tip: grandma 是 grandmother 的口语说法；granny 也常用。
scene: A grandmother with grey hair baking an apple pie in a kitchen.

senses.en: informal word for grandfather

ex.en: Grandpa tells funny stories about his childhood.
ex.zh: 爷爷讲他童年时的趣事。

ex.en: My grandpa grows vegetables in the garden.
ex.zh: 我爷爷在花园里种蔬菜。

tip: grandpa 是 grandfather 的口语说法。
scene: A grandfather watering vegetables in a garden with a watering can.

senses.en: another informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Granny knitted me a warm scarf.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我织了一条温暖的围巾。

ex.en: We are staying at granny's house for the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期我们住在奶奶家。

tip: granny 与 grandma 都是对奶奶/外婆的亲昵称呼。
scene: A grandmother knitting a scarf in a rocking chair by the window.

senses.en: to become an adult

ex.en: She grew up in a small town near the sea.
ex.zh: 她在海边的一个小镇长大。

ex.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
ex.zh: 你长大后想做什么？

tip: grow up 表示“长大成人”；grown-up 是名词“成年人”。
scene: A photo album showing a baby growing into a smiling adult.

senses.en: a small hotel or house where people pay to stay

ex.en: We stayed at a lovely guest-house by the beach.
ex.zh: 我们住在海边一家可爱的家庭旅馆。

ex.en: The guest-house serves breakfast every morning.
ex.zh: 这家家庭旅馆每天早上提供早餐。

tip: guest-house 是小型旅馆，通常比酒店便宜、更温馨。
scene: A cosy small guest-house with flowers by the door near a beach.

senses.en: feeling pleased and cheerful

ex.en: The children look happy playing in the garden.
ex.zh: 孩子们在花园里玩得很开心。

ex.en: I am happy to help you with your homework.
ex.zh: 我很乐意帮你做作业。

tip: happy 的名词是 happiness；be happy with 表示“对…满意”。
scene: Happy children laughing and playing with a ball in a sunny garden.

senses.en: to own, eat, drink, or do something

ex.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
ex.zh: 我有两个哥哥和一个妹妹。

ex.en: We usually have lunch at twelve.
ex.zh: 我们通常十二点吃午饭。

tip: have 用法很多：拥有、吃、喝、开展活动（have a shower）。
scene: A family having lunch together around a round table.

senses.en: must; it is necessary to do something

ex.en: I have got to finish my homework before dinner.
ex.zh: 我必须在晚饭前完成作业。

ex.en: You have got to be careful on the road.
ex.zh: 你过马路必须小心。

tip: have got to 与 have to 意思相同，都表示“必须”，口语常用。
scene: A student looking at the clock while doing homework at a desk.

senses.en: used to say something is necessary

ex.en: I have to get up early tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天必须早起。

ex.en: Do we have to wear a uniform at school?
ex.zh: 我们在学校必须穿校服吗？

tip: have to 表客观需要，must 表主观必须；否定 don't have to 是“不必”。
scene: A student in a school uniform looking at an alarm clock.

senses.en: a male person or animal already mentioned

ex.en: He is my best friend at school.
ex.zh: 他是我在学校最好的朋友。

ex.en: Where is Tom? He is in the garden.
ex.zh: 汤姆在哪？他在花园里。

tip: he 是主格；宾格是 him，形容词性物主代词是 his。
scene: A boy waving from a garden while a friend looks for him.

senses.en: earphones you wear over your head to listen to music

ex.en: She listens to English songs with headphones on.
ex.zh: 她戴着耳机听英文歌。

ex.en: He put on his headphones and started studying.
ex.zh: 他戴上耳机开始学习。

col: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机
tip: headphones 常用复数；一副耳机说 a pair of headphones。
scene: A pair of black headphones lying on a desk next to a laptop.

senses.en: the teacher in charge of a school

ex.en: The headteacher gave a speech at the school assembly.
ex.zh: 校长在全校集会上讲话。

ex.en: Our headteacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 我们的校长知道每个学生的名字。

tip: headteacher 是英式说法，美式常说 principal。
scene: A headteacher in a suit speaking to students in a school hall.

senses.en: in or to this place

ex.en: Come here and look at this picture.
ex.zh: 过来看看这张画。

ex.en: Your keys are here on the table.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在桌上这里。

tip: here you are 是“给你”的口语表达，递交东西时用。
scene: A child pointing to a picture on a table, calling a friend over.

senses.en: something that belongs to a female person

ex.en: This umbrella is not mine; it's hers.
ex.zh: 这把伞不是我的，是她的。

ex.en: My bag is blue and hers is red.
ex.zh: 我的包是蓝色的，她的是红色的。

tip: hers 是名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。
scene: Two school bags, a blue one and a red one, side by side on hooks.

senses.en: used when a female does something to herself

ex.en: She made the cake herself.
ex.zh: 蛋糕是她自己做的。

ex.en: She looked at herself in the mirror.
ex.zh: 她照了照镜子。

tip: by herself 表示“独自、靠自己”；反身代词指代主语的自己。
scene: A girl looking at her reflection in a full-length mirror.

senses.en: an informal greeting

ex.en: Hi, how are you today?
ex.zh: 嗨，你今天好吗？

ex.en: She said hi to everyone in the class.
ex.zh: 她向班里的每个人打招呼。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，朋友间常用。
scene: A girl waving and saying hi to friends at a school gate.

senses.en: used when a male does something to himself

ex.en: He built the bookshelf himself.
ex.zh: 书架是他自己做的。

ex.en: Tom hurt himself playing football.
ex.zh: 汤姆踢足球时弄伤了自己。

tip: by himself 表示“独自”；反身代词 himself 指代男性主语。
scene: A boy proudly standing next to a bookshelf he built himself.

senses.en: a style of music and dance from the city

ex.en: He loves listening to hip hop music.
ex.zh: 他喜欢听嘻哈音乐。

ex.en: They learned hip hop dance at the club.
ex.zh: 他们在俱乐部学街舞。

tip: hip hop 既指嘻哈音乐，也指嘻哈文化/街舞。
scene: A teenager dancing to hip hop music with headphones on in a room.

senses.en: a large animal that lives in African rivers

ex.en: The hippo was swimming in the river.
ex.zh: 河马在河里游泳。

ex.en: We saw a hippo at the zoo on Sunday.
ex.zh: 周日我们在动物园看到了一只河马。

tip: hippo 是 hippopotamus 的简称，复数 hippos。
scene: A large grey hippo half-submerged in a river, only its head showing.

senses.en: belonging to a male person

ex.en: This is his bicycle.
ex.zh: 这是他的自行车。

ex.en: He left his jacket at school.
ex.zh: 他把夹克落在学校了。

tip: his 既是形容词性物主代词（his bike），也是名词性物主代词（it's his）。
scene: A boy getting on his bicycle parked against a wall.

senses.en: a sweatshirt with a hood

ex.en: He wears a grey hoodie every day.
ex.zh: 他每天都穿一件灰色连帽衫。

ex.en: My new hoodie has a pocket in the front.
ex.zh: 我的新连帽衫前面有个口袋。

tip: hoodie 是带帽子的运动衫，学生中很流行。
scene: A grey hoodie hanging on a hanger in a teenager's bedroom.

senses.en: in what way; used in questions

ex.en: How do you go to school?
ex.zh: 你怎么去上学？

ex.en: How beautiful the flowers are!
ex.zh: 这些花多漂亮啊！

tip: how many + 可数名词；how much + 不可数名词或问价格。
scene: A child asking a question with a raised hand in a classroom.

senses.en: the person speaking or writing

ex.en: I am eleven years old.
ex.zh: 我十一岁。

ex.en: I like playing basketball with my friends.
ex.zh: 我喜欢和朋友们打篮球。

tip: 英语中 I 永远大写；宾格是 me。
scene: A girl pointing to herself and smiling in front of a mirror.

senses.en: a cold sweet food made from milk and sugar

ex.en: I'd like a chocolate ice cream, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一个巧克力冰淇淋。

ex.en: The children ate ice cream in the summer sun.
ex.zh: 孩子们在夏日阳光下吃冰淇淋。

tip: ice cream 是可数/不可数兼有：an ice cream 一个冰淇淋。
scene: A girl holding a strawberry ice cream cone on a sunny street.

senses.en: the sport of moving on ice wearing skates

ex.en: We go ice skating every winter.
ex.zh: 我们每年冬天都去滑冰。

ex.en: Ice skating is fun but you have to be careful.
ex.zh: 滑冰很有趣，但要小心。

tip: ice skating 是“滑冰”运动；ice skates 是冰鞋。
scene: A child gliding on an ice rink with other skaters around.

senses.en: a document that proves who you are

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

ex.en: Please show your ID at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口出示证件。

tip: ID 是 identification 的缩写，ID card 是身份证。
scene: A hand holding an ID card in front of a security desk.

senses.en: a card with your name and photo to prove who you are

ex.en: She showed her ID card to the security guard.
ex.zh: 她向保安出示了身份证。

ex.en: Don't forget your ID card when you travel.
ex.zh: 出门旅行别忘了带身份证。

tip: ID card 即身份证/证件卡；英美出行常带 passport 或 driving licence。
scene: A student ID card with a photo lying on a desk.

senses.en: ahead of; before something in position

ex.en: The school is in front of the park.
ex.zh: 学校在公园前面。

ex.en: She stood in front of the class and spoke.
ex.zh: 她站在全班面前发言。

tip: in front of 指“在…前面”；反义词是 behind（在…后面）。
scene: A school building standing in front of a green park with trees.

senses.en: in place of something

ex.en: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我们走路吧，别坐公交车了。

ex.en: She had tea instead of coffee.
ex.zh: 她喝了茶而不是咖啡。

tip: instead of 后接名词/动名词；instead 单独用放在句尾。
scene: Two friends choosing to walk on a path while a bus passes.

senses.en: information telling you how to do something

ex.en: Read the instructions before you use the machine.
ex.zh: 使用机器前请阅读说明书。

ex.en: The instructions on the box are easy to follow.
ex.zh: 盒子上的说明很容易照着做。

tip: instructions 常用复数，指使用说明或操作指示。
scene: A person reading a printed instruction sheet while assembling a shelf.

senses.en: belonging to an animal or thing

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail happily.
ex.zh: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。

ex.en: The phone is in its case.
ex.zh: 手机在它的保护壳里。

tip: its 是“它的”；注意 it's 是 it is 的缩写，二者易混。
scene: A happy dog wagging its tail in a sunny yard.

senses.en: used when an animal or thing does something to itself

ex.en: The cat cleaned itself in the sun.
ex.zh: 猫在阳光下给自己梳理毛发。

ex.en: The door closes by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己会关上。

tip: by itself 表示“自动地/独自地”，如门自动关上。
scene: A cat licking its paw while sitting in a sunny window.

senses.en: a young cat

ex.en: The kitten is playing with a ball of wool.
ex.zh: 小猫在玩毛线球。

ex.en: We adopted a kitten from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我们从动物收容所领养了一只小猫。

tip: kitten 是小猫；成年猫是 cat。
scene: A tiny orange kitten playing with a ball of wool on a carpet.

senses.en: a cold drink made with lemons, sugar and water

ex.en: She made fresh lemonade for the picnic.
ex.zh: 她为野餐做了新鲜的柠檬水。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of lemonade, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一杯柠檬水好吗？

col: a glass of lemonade｜一杯柠檬水
tip: lemonade 是柠檬饮料；英式常指气泡柠檬汽水。
scene: A glass jug of lemonade with lemons on a picnic blanket.

senses.en: to put your body in a flat position to rest

ex.en: I need to lie down for a while; I feel tired.
ex.zh: 我需要躺一会儿，我感觉很累。

ex.en: The dog likes to lie down in the shade.
ex.zh: 狗喜欢躺在阴凉处。

tip: lie down 是“躺下”休息；过去式 lay down。
scene: A tired woman lying down on a sofa with a blanket.

senses.en: the room in a house where people relax together

ex.en: We watch TV in the living room every evening.
ex.zh: 我们每天晚上在客厅看电视。

ex.en: The living room has a big sofa and a coffee table.
ex.zh: 客厅里有一张大沙发和一张茶几。

tip: living room 与 sitting room 同义，都是客厅/起居室。
scene: A cosy living room with a sofa, coffee table and a TV.

senses.en: to take care of someone or something

ex.en: My sister looks after our cat when we travel.
ex.zh: 我们旅行时，姐姐照顾我们的猫。

ex.en: Please look after your little brother.
ex.zh: 请照顾好你的小弟弟。

tip: look after 等于 take care of，都表示“照顾”。
scene: A girl gently feeding a cat with a bowl of food.

senses.en: to direct your eyes towards something

ex.en: Look at the picture and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 看这幅图并回答问题。

ex.en: He looked at the clock and hurried out.
ex.zh: 他看了看钟，匆匆出去了。

tip: look at 是“看着某物”；watch 是“注视动态画面”，如看电视。
scene: A student looking closely at a picture book at a desk.

senses.en: to try to find something

ex.en: I am looking for my keys. Have you seen them?
ex.zh: 我在找我的钥匙，你看见了吗？

ex.en: She is looking for a summer job.
ex.zh: 她在找暑期工作。

tip: look for 是“寻找”的过程；find 是“找到”的结果。
scene: A girl searching through her bag looking for her keys.

senses.en: to be careful to avoid danger

ex.en: Look out! There's a car coming.
ex.zh: 小心！有车来了。

ex.en: Look out for wet floors after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后注意湿滑的地面。

tip: look out 用于提醒危险，类似 watch out。
scene: A child at a street corner warning a friend as a car approaches.

senses.en: the good or bad things that happen by chance

ex.en: Good luck with your exam tomorrow!
ex.zh: 祝你明天考试好运！

ex.en: She had no luck finding a parking space.
ex.zh: 她运气不好，没找到停车位。

tip: good luck 是祝福语；lucky 是形容词“幸运的”。
scene: A four-leaf clover lying on a desk next to a good luck card.

senses.en: the main dish of a meal

ex.en: The main course was chicken with rice.
ex.zh: 主菜是鸡肉配米饭。

ex.en: What would you like for your main course?
ex.zh: 你的主菜想吃什么？

tip: 西餐顺序：starter（前菜）→ main course（主菜）→ dessert（甜点）。
scene: A plate of grilled chicken with rice and vegetables served on a table.

senses.en: used to ask permission or say something is possible

ex.en: May I use your pen, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以用你的钢笔吗？

ex.en: It may rain later, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 待会儿可能下雨，带把伞吧。

tip: may 用于请求更正式礼貌；表示可能性时比 might 更可能。
scene: A student politely asking a classmate to borrow a pen.
